name: Sign Rank / Combinatorial Eluder Dimension (Affine Incomparable)
details: Neither affine comparison holds. Since S<=Edim and sign rank is controlled by a nondecreasing function of S, there is nonetheless a finite-valued sign-rank upper bound in Edim. The reverse functional bound fails. The established functional theorem therefore excludes constant-Edim/unbounded-sign-rank families.
parameter_1_larger_witness: On #classes/parity_functions, SR>=2^n while combinatorial eluder dimension is exactly 2n, so the ratio diverges.
parameter_2_larger_witness: On #classes/singletons_plus_empty_set with n>=4, combinatorial eluder dimension is n and sign rank is three.
proof_source: Survey cor:signrank-parity-separations and database-owned endpoint proofs.
